This '''Muun''' was a contact of [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane's]] used for face-to-face meetings to set up an extensive information network using funds taken from the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]], especially from Lord [[Qordis]]. When Bane's [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith]] [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Apprentice]] wondered why Bane let the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] live, he told her that the Muun was still of use and killing him prematurely would be a waste. The Muun may have also been a part of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]]. Darth Bane was not his only client, as he had stated that anonymity was the reason people went to him when Bane requested reassurance. He was able to secure payments through third-party means that were completely untraceable to their sources.
